discussion.body:
High-level path into Act 7 cataclysm. Does not rewrite locked acts, roster, or the single ending. Act 7 stays FEAT-020: Cannon / Fissure mouth, Vortan fires or is one latch short, north wrecks, party thrown to scarred overworld, airship frees, Deep key does not exist yet. Ending stays Act 13 / FEAT-044 / FEAT-037.
Spine (each act loads one latch on the shot): Act 0 Padon/WillowDale — wrong weather and a distant Cannon tick. Cael only. No temple, no join, no death. Act 1 Breskshire — levy for Constium, first Cannon sightline, heat-death with no fire (Nyxara leak, not Vortan cruelty). Rook and Halric join. Liraen already on the Gate road. Halric crisis at the heat scene. Act 2 Constium — Earth/Keystone, generous Vortan, barrel aims at Fire not the Invasion. Brann joins. Shop-floor accident. His gauging book is the Act 7 latch. Act 3 Bengenia — Mist/Veil cannot be cleared. Velith unmasked as smotherer. Seris joins. Optional Bengenia wipe is a scar, not a second ending. Velith leftover can flood Act 7 if she lives. Act 4 Iunum — Water/Undertow, airship framed not flown, Invasion smoke on the east cape. Nym joins. Dock-fire crisis. Cove notes finish the ship after the shot. Act 5 war front — refuse Breskshire kill-order, Ash joins. Fire/Cinder half-occupied. Nyxara answers a prayer not sent to her. Mid-boss is bombardier or Velith remnant, not Nyxara. Ash/Halric crises. Act 6 Tierso — Ysolde locks, Maera joins. Life/Root and Light/Meridian described as Fissure seals, not Cannon fuel. Preview talk only: bind temples vs let Vortan fire. No route fork.
Load state walking into Act 7: - Six Sigils in hand (Keystone, Veil, Undertow, Cinder, Root, Meridian — Veil may be ruin-recovered). None of them power the barrel. - Two leads alive. Main-side defaults live; graves only from marked crises. - Party knows the barrel points at Fire, Brann's book can drop a latch, Velith smothers rather than rules, Nyxara already speaks through Fire. - Airship exists as a frame. It flies after the throw-back, not before.
Act 7 sequence (already locked, restated as destination): loading city - barrel dungeon - Fire terrace / Fissure mouth - Vortan fires or misses one latch - north cataclysm - party ejected - Deep Fissure visible then rubble-sealed - FEAT-045 open world. Brann barrel-climb crisis still marked. Do not stage Nyxara last fight here.
Pressure curve: weather wrong (0) - industry kind (2) - religion false (3) - war refuses the easy kill (5) - south temples name the real lock (6) - north machine opens the lock it meant to kill (7).
